question: Which of the following titles was held by Prince Phillip, the late husband of Queen Elizabeth II, until his death in April 2021?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Duke of Edinburgh**__**.**

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

 
• **Titles held by Prince Phillip,** the late husband of Queen Elizabeth II, until his death in April 2021 were:

 
 
• **​Duke of Edinburgh.**
 
• **Earl of Merioneth and Baron Greenwich.**
 
• **Prince of Greece and Denmark.**
 
 
 
• ​Philip’s father was **Prince Andrew of Greece and Denmark (1882–1944).**
 
• His** mother was Princess Alice** (1885–1969), granddaughter of Queen Victoria.
 
• Philip was** educated at Gordonstoun School, near Elgin, Moray, Scotland,** and **at the Royal Naval College, Dartmouth, Devon, England.**
 
• From January 1940 to the end of** World War II, he served with the Royal Navy** in combat in the Mediterranean and the Pacific.
 
• His** marriage to his distant cousin Princess Elizabeth **took place in Westminster Abbey on **November 20, 1947.**
